annotations.title: Extract data from a document: invoice, receipt, contract fields as JSON

description: Extract named fields from a document as JSON: give a PDF, Word, Excel or PowerPoint file, a scan or a photo (PNG, JPEG, WebP) by URL or in a POST body (up to 10 MB; images 3 MB) and the field names you want, such as invoice_number, total, due_date. An AI model reads the file, scans by OCR, and returns one JSON object, with null where a value is not stated. Use to turn invoices, receipts, orders and contracts into rows. Price $0.03/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

url.description: Absolute public http(s) URL of the file (or send the file in a POST body instead)
